Diego asked me to set up a 30-minute meeting with you **today, Wednesday, at 10:00 AM**. He mentioned you spoke in the hallway and that your faculty senate meeting at that hour is cancelled this week, so you're free then — I understand your calendar may still show the senate block.

Could you confirm the 10:00–10:30 slot and put it on your calendar? Once you do, I'll hold it on Diego's side too. If 10:00 doesn't work after all, just tell me a time that does and I'll rearrange.

Thanks!
